title: Strobe tuner (demo)
description: A demo firmware built with OpenGP5: the guitar straight through, with a strobe tuner on the screen (guitar and 5-string bass). Foot switch = mute, PARA = reference pitch, volume knob = level.

title: Dreamcatcher
description: Ambient textures: always-listening micro-looper, chance-driven glitch delay and reverb, 8 presets. From github.com/OpenGP5/Dreamcatcher.
